actions: Enabled VoiceOver through System Settings. The first Use VoiceOver followed by a query of the closed Quickstart reached Tutorial; closing Tutorial returned VoiceOver off. Retained as a transient failed setup, not successful readout.
Enabled again and clicked the observed Use VoiceOver button coordinates without querying the transient app after closure. Read-only process inspection confirmed VoiceOver and scrod running.
Attempted access to VoiceOver caption surface by exact bundle path and bundle identifier. Both CUA getApp calls returned timeoutReached; app inventory omitted the background-only VoiceOver app.

Seeded the clipboard through disposable Description text with VOICEOVER_CAPTURE_SENTINEL_1004. Focused Title and sent Control-Option-F4, then Control-Option-Shift-C. Pasted into Description. The sentinel remained, and Title contained U+0003.
voiceOver.interpretation: The controlled sentinel prevented stale clipboard text from being accepted as speech. The result is consistent with the targeted input route not reaching the global VoiceOver command handler, but does not establish a production screen-reader defect.
limitations: CUA exposes per-App/Target screenshot methods; no full-display screenshot or direct global-key API was documented.
